scenarios.title: Extract Text Segments
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Enter text + optional language tag; Word Segments / Selection Segments print segment bounds to the status area. Empty input yields "Cannot compute word/selection segments: input string is empty."

scenarios.title: Get Current Text Segment From Index
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Enter text, language tag, and an index; Word Segment / Selection Segment print the segment containing that index. Empty input yields the empty-input status message.
